description: Behavioral contract for rule-026 lint; code snippets are parsed, never compiled or executed. Shared Rust tokenization excludes comments and literals. Scope/baseline policy still belongs to cas-b453 implementation.

cases.name: parallel-unguarded-env
cases.source: #[test] fn race() { unsafe { std::env::set_var("HOME", "other"); } }

cases.name: unguarded-factory-helper
cases.source: struct FactorySessionEnv; impl FactorySessionEnv { fn set() { unsafe { std::env::set_var("CAS_FACTORY_SESSION", "child"); } } } #[test] fn focus() { FactorySessionEnv::set(); }

cases.name: nested-shared-guard
cases.source: #[test] fn nested() { let _outer = TestEnvGuard::new(); let _inner = TestEnvGuard::new(); }

cases.name: unguarded-remove
cases.source: #[test] fn remove() { unsafe { std::env::remove_var("CAS_FACTORY_SESSION"); } }

cases.name: unguarded-cwd
cases.source: #[test] fn cwd() { std::env::set_current_dir(".").unwrap(); }

cases.name: guarded-setters
cases.source: #[test] fn safe() { let mut guard = TestEnvGuard::new(); guard.set("HOME", "other"); guard.remove("CAS_FACTORY_SESSION"); guard.set_current_dir("."); }

cases.name: child-command-env
cases.source: #[test] fn child() { std::process::Command::new("fixture").env("HOME", "child").env_remove("CAS_FACTORY_SESSION").current_dir("."); }

cases.name: nested-temp-home-callback
cases.source: #[test] fn nested() { TestEnvGuard::run_with_temp_home(|_| { let _inner = TestEnvGuard::new(); }); }

cases.name: nested-helper-call
cases.source: fn fixture() { let _fixture = TestEnvGuard::temp_home(); } #[test] fn nested() { let _outer = TestEnvGuard::new(); fixture(); }

cases.name: constructor-alias
cases.source: use crate::test_support::TestEnvGuard as Guard; #[test] fn nested() { let _outer = Guard::new(); let _inner = Guard::temp_home(); }

cases.name: mutation-import-alias
cases.source: use std::env::set_var as change; #[test] fn bad() { unsafe { change("HOME", "other"); } }

cases.name: dropped-guard-then-new
cases.source: #[test] fn sequence() { let first = TestEnvGuard::new(); drop(first); let _second = TestEnvGuard::new(); }

cases.name: disjoint-guard-scopes
cases.source: #[test] fn sequence() { { let _first = TestEnvGuard::new(); } { let _second = TestEnvGuard::new(); } }

cases.name: new-thread-separate-ownership
cases.source: #[test] fn thread() { let outer = TestEnvGuard::new(); let child = std::thread::spawn(|| { let _child = TestEnvGuard::new(); }); drop(outer); child.join().unwrap(); }

cases.name: literal-comment-distractions
cases.source: #[test] fn pure() { let source = r###"std::env::set_var("HOME", "x"); TestEnvGuard::new(); }"###; /* outer /* std::env::remove_var("HOME"); */ comment */ let quoted = "TestEnvGuard::new()"; }

cases.name: lexical-spacing
cases.source: #[test] fn bad() { unsafe { std :: env :: set_var ("HOME", "other"); } }

cases.name: second-guard-in-branch
cases.source: #[test] fn nested() { let _outer = TestEnvGuard::new(); if true { let _inner = TestEnvGuard::new(); } }

cases.name: non-test-production-mutation
cases.source: fn startup() { unsafe { std::env::set_var("CAS_FACTORY_SESSION", "factory"); } }

cases.name: child-only-deliberate-nesting
cases.source:
// test-env: subprocess-only — ignored bounded re-exec child proves nesting panics
#[test] #[ignore = "isolated child probe"] #[should_panic] fn child() { let _outer = TestEnvGuard::new(); let _inner = TestEnvGuard::new(); }

cases.name: child-exception-cannot-protect-ordinary-test
cases.source:
// test-env: subprocess-only — missing isolated child contract
#[test] fn ordinary() { unsafe { std::env::set_var("HOME", "other"); } }
